content: Is there an elaborator or other tool to get Haskell/Rocq-style GADTs with the expected recursion/induction principles in Lean? The best I could hack together (with LLM assistance for surveying existing codebases) was this, and it's both more manual than I'd like for iterating on GADT declarations quickly, does not plug into the match elaborator, and leaves me with a cast in the recursor. What's the state of the art in this space? (Searching for issues does give some past discussion on that topic but nothing there sticks out as promising.)

General GADTs are handled by Lean, the specific case of the expr type you're trying to define isn't. In particular, Lean doesn't currently handle nested indexed inductive types too well, the best solution currently is to translate your nested type into a mutual one as your LLM did.
